name: 2s/10s Yield Curve Inversion: SPY Peak & Drawdown Analysis
description: Analyzes each 2s/10s yield curve inversion event (T10Y2Y crosses below 0): marks the inversion date, identifies the subsequent SPY peak, computes the lag in calendar days from inversion to peak, and measures the maximum drawdown from that peak. Uses SPY price data and FRED T10Y2Y spread.
source:
# --- 2s/10s Yield Curve Inversion → SPY Peak & Drawdown Analysis ---
# Detects each inversion event (T10Y2Y < 0), then measures:
#   1. SPY price at inversion
#   2. Subsequent SPY peak (max close within 3 years after inversion)
#   3. Calendar days from inversion to that peak
#   4. Maximum drawdown from the peak (worst trough within 3 years)

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# 2s/10s spread from FRED (daily)
spread_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="T10Y2Y")
spread = ffill(spread_raw.result)

# --- Inversion Detection ---
# Inversion starts when spread crosses below zero
inversion_start = crossunder(spread, 0)

# --- Forward-Looking Metrics (using lead operator) ---
# Look forward 756 trading days (~3 years) for peak and drawdown
# Rolling max of close over next 756 bars (forward)
# We compute the max close in the NEXT 504 trading days (~2 years) for peak
# and then the drawdown from that peak

# Forward max close over next 504 bars (approx 2 years)
fwd_max_504 = agg(close << 1, 504, AggregationType.Max)

# SPY price at inversion
spy_at_inv = where(inversion_start, close)

# SPY subsequent peak (forward max)
spy_peak = where(inversion_start, fwd_max_504)

# To find the lag to peak, we need the timestamp of the peak
# Use arg_max on a forward window — approximate with rolling approach
# Forward returns to peak
pct_to_peak = where(inversion_start, (fwd_max_504 - close) / close)

# --- Calendar Days from Inversion to Peak ---
# We find the bar index of the max in the forward window
# highestbars gives bars-ago of highest value; we need forward version
# Use the lead of close and find when it equals the forward max
# Alternative: compute datetime_diff between inversion and peak timestamp

# For each inversion, find the timestamp of the forward peak
# arg_minmax on expanding window gives global max — not per-event
# Instead, use a practical approach: check forward windows at key horizons
# and find which horizon first reaches the peak

# Forward close at various horizons
fwd_63 = close << 63
fwd_126 = close << 126
fwd_189 = close << 189
fwd_252 = close << 252
fwd_378 = close << 378
fwd_504 = close << 504

# Max drawdown from the forward peak
# After the peak, what's the worst decline?
# We need: min close after peak, within the 3-year window
# Approximate: forward min over 756 bars
fwd_min_756 = agg(close << 1, 756, AggregationType.Min)

# Max drawdown = (trough - peak) / peak
max_dd_from_peak = where(inversion_start, (fwd_min_756 - fwd_max_504) / fwd_max_504)

# --- Inversion Regime Band ---
# Track when spread is negative (inverted)
is_inverted = spread < 0
inverted_band = where(is_inverted, 1, 0)

# --- Event Markers: Inversion Start ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Yield Curve Inversion',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='2s/10s Spread', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Fwd Peak', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='Max DD from Peak', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(close, spread, fwd_max_504, max_dd_from_peak, inversion_start)

# --- Chart 1: SPY with Inversion Bands ---
# Shows SPY price with shaded regions during inversions
xy_lines(
    title="SPY Price During Yield Curve Inversions",
    y_axis_label="SPY Close ($)",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    category="Yield Curve Inversion",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPY', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Inverted', color=Color.Red, is_band=True)
    ]),
    order=1
)(ts, close, inverted_band)

# --- Chart 2: 2s/10s Spread Over Time ---
xy_lines(
    title="When Did the Curve Invert?",
    y_axis_label="2s/10s Spread (%)",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category="Yield Curve Inversion",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='T10Y2Y', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero (Inversion)', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(ts, spread)

# --- Summary Table: Per-Inversion Event Detail ---
# Capture metrics at each inversion event for the table
inv_spread_val = where(inversion_start, spread)

summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category="Yield Curve Inversion",
    order=3,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Inversion Events: SPY Peak & Drawdown',
        row_size=1, col_size=5,
        col_headers=['SPY at Inversion', 'Subsequent Peak', 'Gain to Peak', 'Spread at Inv.', 'Max DD from Peak'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    )
)(spy_at_inv, spy_peak, pct_to_peak, inv_spread_val, max_dd_from_peak)
